description:
7th connection. 6th connection CONFIRMED SUCCESS for the core exercise: JUCSRV rebuilt end-to-end via git clone + CRTRPGMOD/CRTSRVPGM SRCSTMF (Module JUCSRV placed, 10 highest severity; Service program JUCSRV created, old object correctly moved to QRPLOBJ; CHECK702/CHECK703 both resolved and ran it correctly via *LIBL - same values as the member-based build). The CL line-length fix (shortened v8/b.git/p/c paths, +-continued CRTRPGMOD/CRTSRVPGM statements) and the ADDLIBLE-in-one-job fix (dynamically generated BUILDMOD CL helper) both worked as designed.

Only ROUNDTRIP-EDIT failed, on a NEW instance of the same class of bug already fixed twice elsewhere in this manifest: the heredoc-written ed.py python script was itself written as EBCDIC bytes (this harness's own well-established heredoc-write default), so python3 refused to parse it (SyntaxError: non-UTF-8 code, no encoding declared). A PEP 263 coding-declaration comment cannot fix this - Python's own bootstrap scan for that comment assumes the first two lines are already ASCII-compatible, which EBCDIC bytes are not. Fixed the same way the jucsrv.rpgle/jucsrv.bnd seed was fixed: ed.py is now a real source member (QTXTSRC/EDPY, added via this manifest's own file-type step, so CPYFRMSTMF - proven safe for EBCDIC-native member content) exported to the IFS via CPYTOSTMF (STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF), the same already-twice-proven recipe), instead of ever going through a heredoc write for this specific file.

steps.label: PCREPO
steps.cmd: cd "$HOME/v8" && mkdir -p p/src/qrpglesrc p/src/qsrvsrc && cd p && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git init -b main 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git config user.name 'Learner (verify harness rehearsal)' 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git config user.email 'learner-rehearsal-no-email' 2>&1 && system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QRPGLESRC.FILE/JUCSRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/v8/p/src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1 && system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QSRVSRC.FILE/JUCSRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/v8/p/src/qsrvsrc/jucsrv.bnd') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1 && echo ---SEED-CHECK--- && ls -S src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle 2>&1 && od -x src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle 2>&1 | head -2 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git add -A 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git commit -m 'initial import: JUCSRV source' 2>&1

steps.label: PUSH
steps.cmd: cd "$HOME/v8/p" && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git remote add origin "$HOME/v8/b.git" 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git --no-pager push origin main 2>&1

steps.label: CLONE
steps.cmd: cd "$HOME/v8" && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git clone b.git c 2>&1 && echo ---CLONE-CHECK--- && ls -S c/src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle 2>&1 && od -x c/src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle 2>&1 | head -2

steps.label: GENBUILDER
steps.cmd:
cat > "$HOME/v8/bm.clp" <<CLEOF
             PGM
             MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000 RNF0000 MCH0000) EXEC(GOTO CMDLBL(FAILSAFE))
             ADDLIBLE LIB(&LIB) POSITION(*FIRST)
             MONMSG MSGID(CPF2103)
             DLTMOD MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV)
             MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
             CRTRPGMOD MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV) +
  SRCSTMF('$HOME/v8/c/src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle') +
  TGTCCSID(*JOB) REPLACE(*YES)
             CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/JUCSRV) MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV) +
  EXPORT(*SRCFILE) +
  SRCSTMF('$HOME/v8/c/src/qsrvsrc/jucsrv.bnd') +
  ACTGRP(*CALLER) REPLACE(*YES)
             RETURN
FAILSAFE:    SNDPGMMSG MSG('BUILDMOD: unexpected error.') MSGTYPE(*COMP)
CLEOF
awk '{ print length, $0 }' "$HOME/v8/bm.clp"
system "CPYFRMSTMF FROMSTMF('$HOME/v8/bm.clp') TOMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QCLSRC.FILE/BUILDMOD.MBR') MBROPT(*REPLACE)" 2>&1
system "DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/BUILDMOD)" 2>&1
system "CRTCLPGM PGM(&LIB/BUILDMOD) SRCFILE(&LIB/QCLSRC) SRCMBR(BUILDMOD) REPLACE(*YES)" 2>&1

steps.label: GENEDITOR
steps.cmd:
system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QTXTSRC.FILE/EDPY.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/v8/ed.py') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1
cat "$HOME/v8/ed.py"

steps.label: ROUNDTRIP-EDIT
steps.cmd: cd "$HOME/v8/p" && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/python3 "$HOME/v8/ed.py" 2>&1 && echo ---EDIT-CHECK--- && ls -S src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle 2>&1 && od -x src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle 2>&1 | head -2 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git add -A 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git commit -m 'round-trip rehearsal: add a comment line' 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git --no-pager push origin main 2>&1

steps.sql: SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJLIB FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB', 'ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME = 'JUCSRV' ORDER BY OBJTYPE

SELECT PROGRAM_NAME, BOUND_SERVICE_PROGRAM_LIBRARY, BOUND_SERVICE_PROGRAM, BOUND_SERVICE_PROGRAM_ACTIVATION FROM QSYS2.BOUND_SRVPGM_INFO WHERE PROGRAM_LIBRARY = '&LIB' AND PROGRAM_NAME IN ('F0702A', 'F0703A') ORDER BY PROGRAM_NAME
